name: colossal_squid
description: Colossal squid (Mesonychoteuthis hamiltoni), side view: very wide heavy red-maroon mantle (#b33a3a, chromatophore dots) at the left tapering to broad rounded fins at the tip, one huge pale silver-blue eye under a heavy lid, eight short thick arms and two longer tentacles to the right, with rows of small pale swivelling hooks on the arms and tentacle clubs. Anchor centre, bbox ~x -462..472, y -165..165.
